description: Inert OpenClaw gateway LaunchAgent and a live listener on the gateway port.
demo_beat: step 4 support - the unattended daemon and its listener
why: daemon and port were both IN lists before D20 -- three label prefixes and four port numbers. Now launchd enumerates every non-Apple job (937 down to 47 on a reference Mac, and the exclusion is the platform vendor, not a catalog) and listening_ports returns every real listener. An inference server on an uncatalogued port is exactly the shadow-AI case the old IN list could not see.
